items.name: Allseas Contract for Development Work and Commercial Production
items.claim: On May 11, 2026, TMC announced it had signed a Contract for Development Work and Commercial Production with Allseas for the development, commissioning and operation of the first commercial polymetallic nodule collection system, with a nameplate production capacity of 3.0 million wet tonnes of nodules per annum, commissioning targeted for Q4 2027.
items.source_excerpt: On May 11, 2026, we announced that we had signed a Contract for Development Work and Commercial Production with our strategic partner and investor Allseas, a global leader in offshore pipeline installation, heavy lift and subsea construction, for the development, commissioning and operation of the first commercial polymetallic nodule collection system. The agreement establishes the commercial framework for advancing offshore nodule recovery operations and builds on the successful pilot collection test completed in 2022. The commercial system is expected to have a nameplate production capacity of 3.0 million wet tonnes of nodules per annum, with commissioning targeted to begin in Q4 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.

items.name: Mariana Minerals MSA for Port of Brownsville nodule processing and refining park
items.claim: On July 21, 2026, TMC USA entered into a Master Services Agreement with Mariana Minerals for a phased program to advance a proposed polymetallic nodule processing and refining industry park at the Port of Brownsville, Texas, beginning with mobilization, concept development and technical design work.
items.source_excerpt: On July 21, 2026, TMC USA entered into a Master Services Agreement with Mariana Minerals for a phased program to advance a proposed polymetallic nodule processing and refining industry park at the Port of Brownsville, Texas, beginning with mobilization, concept development and technical design work to establish plant feasibility and design basis — building on the internal prefeasibility study commissioned by TMC USA from a third-party engineering firm

items.name: ISA approves NORI exploration contract five-year extension
items.claim: On July 20, 2026, the ISA Council approved by consensus a five-year extension of NORI's exploration contract in the Clarion-Clipperton Zone.
items.source_excerpt: On July 20, 2026, the ISA Council approved by consensus a five-year extension of NORI's exploration contract in the Clarion-Clipperton Zone

items.name: NOAA USA-A exploration license and commercial recovery permit application: full compliance
items.claim: On April 28, 2026, NOAA determined that the consolidated application by TMC's subsidiary, TMC USA, for an exploration license and commercial recovery permit for the USA-A area under DSHMRA is in full compliance with the requirements of the Act and its implementing regulations.
items.source_excerpt: On April 28, 2026, NOAA determined that the consolidated application by our subsidiary, TMC USA, for an exploration license and commercial recovery permit for the USA-A area under DSHMRA is in full compliance with the requirements of the Act and its implementing regulations, marking a key step in the U.S. regulatory and permitting process.

items.name: USA-A and USA-B nodule resource areas under NOAA review
items.claim: TMC USA's consolidated USA-A application and USA-B exploration license application continue to progress through NOAA's review; the USA-A area covers approximately 65,000 km² with an estimated 619 million tonnes of wet nodules and potential exploration upside of an additional 200 million tonnes, while the USA-B area covers approximately 122,000 km² and hosts an estimated 1.02 billion tonnes of polymetallic nodules.
items.source_excerpt: The Company’s USA-A area covers approximately 65,000 km² with an estimated 619 million tonnes of wet nodules and potential exploration upside of an additional 200 million tonnes; the USA-B area covers approximately 122,000 km² and hosts an estimated 1.02 billion tonnes of polymetallic nodules

It discloses three named contracts/awards (Allseas commercial development agreement, Mariana Minerals MSA, ISA/NORI exploration contract extension) and two project-pipeline items (the two NOAA USA-A/USA-B exploration license and commercial recovery permit applications, with resource tonnage estimates).
